description_en: Calls the DetectImageFaces operation to detect faces and face information in an image
description_zh: 调用DetectImageFaces接口检测图片中的人脸及人脸信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm detect-image-faces --project immimagetest --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/facetest.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectImageFaces

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri
